* New: «On consignment» in the Author Portal (with Trade Accounts 1.8.0+): per bookstore and title, all time, copies given, sold, returned and on the shelf (with the settle-by date), money collected and owed, and the expected share of what is owed. The expected share is not part of the payable balance: money counts only when collected.
* New: money from bookstores is labelled. «By product» shows «of which X received from <bookstore>» under the title, and «N + part» when a payment covered only part of a copy (with an explanation); the transaction history shows each receipt as «Consignment receipt» with the bookstore and the creator's share, for display only (it is already in the sales shares). The monthly statement PDF shows the same labels and a new block «On consignment at the end of the month». No amount, share or balance changes.
* New: the copies register, Noxpress → RS Copies («Κινήσεις αντιτύπων»), for copies that leave the warehouse without an e-shop sale or a consignment: promotion / gift, review / press, legal deposit, author copies per contract, author purchase, damaged / destroyed, and return to the warehouse. No orders are made. Managed stock changes with each movement and «Undo» puts it back. An author purchase has a unit price and, per entry, a payment mode: offset against the balance (a Ledger «Deduction», removed again on undo) or paid separately (no balance change). A warning shows when the author has an e-shop order of the same title in the last 30 days. Marking an author copies request done opens the form prefilled. The register starts empty.
* New: «Where the copies went» per title in the Author Portal: sold in the e-shop, sold via bookstores, on consignment, free copies by type, the author's copies and stock, with the list of movements. Recipients: media and press by name, private persons only as «private person».
* New abilities `copies-list` (read), `copies-add` (with dry run) and `copies-undo`.
* Changed: the «Stock» column of the Author Portal and of the exports shows «—» instead of «∞» for products that do not manage stock (the admin table keeps «∞»).

stable.changelog:
* New: automatic schedule of the write window, per site (Access → Window schedule, off by default). Up to 3 ranges a day in the site's time zone, a range may run past midnight, up to 30 closed dates. Ranges that touch count as one stretch, and no stretch may be longer than 12 hours (the longest manual window); a DST night is cut at 12 hours too. Worked out on every check, so it is right without cron; one WP-Cron event at the next change only writes the log and sends the e-mail.
* New: "Close now" inside a scheduled stretch (WP admin, Hub, app or Claude's write_window_close) pauses the schedule until that stretch ends; the next one opens as planned. Opening by hand inside a stretch keeps the later end.
* New: an e-mail to the admin address for every change of the write window: opened or closed by hand (and by whom: WP admin, Hub, app or Claude), opened or closed by the schedule, paused, and every schedule edit (before and after). Setting in Access, on by default.
* The site's status gives the Hub and the app what keeps the window open (manual / schedule), the next scheduled opening and the end of a pause; the Hub's Sites tab and list_sites show them. The Site Bridge app 1.8.0 notifies about every change.
* The schedule lives in option sbr_schedule, which no Site Bridge tool can write. Uninstall removes it and its cron event.
